module: Editor helper: imgui 2D graph (grid, axes, points, optional Catmull-Rom curve, crosshair, vertical annotations) with mouse panning (left-button drag) and wheel zoom. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/util/plotHelperUtil')(params). Useful to plot curves (e.g. JBeam tables) in an editor window. Each instance gets a unique id (local counter) for its imgui identifiers.
usage:
local plot = require('/lua/ge/extensions/editor/util/plotHelperUtil')({autoScale = true, showCatmullRomCurve = true})
plot:setData({{0, 0, 1}, {1, 2, 3}, {2, 4, 5}}) -- {x, y1, y2...}
plot:setSeriesNames({'A', 'B'})
-- in onEditorGui, in an imgui window:
plot:draw(400, 300, dt)
notes: Format of the setData data: {{x0, y0, y1, ...}, ...}; setDataMulti already expects series: data[series][i] = {x, y}.
50 px margin (borderSize) around the plot area; a point out of bounds gives nil in graphPtToImSS / graphPtToImWS (except clampVal).

init: without parameters, scale -5..5, showCatmullRomCurve = true, catmullDataPoints = 10 (field never read again: the code uses catmullromCurveLines, 10 by default). allowZoom is true by default (params.allowZoom or true, set to false only if params.allowZoom == false).
Default label formats: '%0.3f' (formatX, formatY); point size 4, thickness 2.
Inconsistency in the code: setScale computes centerPos as the half-extent ((max-min)/2) and not the center; the comments of setSeriesColors and setSeriesFormat say "names" through copy-paste.
draw returns early, without EndChild, if self.data is nil (BeginChild1 already called).

init.desc: Initializes the graph. params.scale = {xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax}, params.initData, params.autoScale, params.showCatmullRomCurve, params.catmullromCurveLines (> 200 recommended), params.allowZoom, pointSize, pointThickness, formatX, formatY.

setData.desc: Sets the data in the format {{x0, y0, y1, ...}, ...} (several y values per x), converted to series then passed to setDataMulti.

setDataMulti.desc: Sets the data per series: data[series] = list of {x, y}. Recomputes the scale if autoScale, and the Catmull-Rom points if showCatmullRomCurve.

setSeriesNames.desc: Sets the series names (list); default name tostring(i).

setSeriesColors.desc: Sets the series colors in the format {r, g, b, a} with values from 0 to 1 (converts to U32). Without a color, the series uses rainbowColor.

setSeriesFormat.desc: Directly replaces the series format table (name, color, uColor per series).

setAnnotationX.desc: Sets the vertical annotations: list of {x, label} pairs, drawn as a line and text in the graph.

scaleToFitData.desc: Adjusts the domain and range to contain all points, with a 10% margin on each side. No effect without data.

setScale.desc: Sets the graph bounds; each parameter is optional (nil = unchanged).

moveGraph.desc: Pans the graph when dragging with the left button (the initial click must be inside the graph).

zoomGraph.desc: Wheel zoom according to the mouse position; no effect if allowZoom is false or if the mouse is outside the graph.

dt.desc: Time delta (the zoom depends on it).

draw.desc: Main method to call on every graph update, in an imgui window: handles the mouse, creates an imgui child and draws the grid, data, Catmull-Rom curve, crosshair and annotations.

overlayTextLines.desc: Displays lines of text overlaid at the top left of the graph.

generateCatmullSplinePoints.desc: Generates the Catmull-Rom curve points for each series (adapted from lua/vehicle/ve_utils.lua, modified for several y); series with fewer than 2 points ignored, series with 2 points copied as is.

drawData.desc: Draws the points of each series (series color or rainbowColor).

drawGridAndAxesLabels.desc: Draws the grid and the axis labels.

getOptimalTickIncrement.desc: Computes the tick increment (1, 2 or 5 depending on the order of magnitude) closest to the desired number of ticks.

getOrderOfMagnitude.desc: Returns the exponent x of num written as a * 10^x.

normToImSS.desc: Imgui coordinates (screen space) from normalized coordinates: (0,0) bottom left, (1,1) top right.

normToImWS.desc: Like normToImSS but in window space.

graphPtToImSS.desc: Imgui coordinates (screen space) of a graph point; nil if the point is out of bounds, except with clampVal (values clamped to 0..1).

graphPtToImWS.desc: Imgui coordinates (window space) of a graph point; nil if out of bounds.

scaleX.desc: Converts a normalized fraction x (0..1) to a graph x value according to the current scale.

scaleY.desc: Converts a normalized fraction y (0..1) to a graph y value according to the current scale.
